info.name: TCOS Finance Tracking — Payments & Reimbursement Approval (chompoo)
info.description:
For a single unattended Collection Runner pass across ALL domains, use `TCOS-Full-Suite.postman_collection.json` instead.

The 5 endpoints from this pass — POST /payments (#37, service token), POST /payments/approve (#40, step-up), POST /reimbursements/:id/status (#47, step-up), GET /reimbursements/:id/document (#48), POST /reimbursements/import (#49) — plus POST /reimbursements (#41, not itself one of the 5 but required plumbing: #47/#48 need a real reimbursement to act on).

Self-contained: includes its own Login requests (multiple actors — head/finance/owner all play different real roles here) so this collection runs standalone. Uses real seeded data: project `TCOS Annual Event 2026`, department `Finance` (chompoo is head+finance there), source `Booth Sponsor A`.

**A reauth token (`X-Reauth-Token`) is scoped to whoever verified it** — it won't work for a different Bearer token, even a valid one. Whenever the acting user changes, re-run Verify Password for that specific user right before the step that needs it (steps 5, 6b, 9 all do this — don't skip 6b thinking 5's token still counts for beam).

**Run order (approval chain)**: 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 (Finance login) → 5 → 6 (Owner login) → **6b (re-verify as beam)** → 7 → 7b. **Payments**: 8 → 9 (Finance login + step-up) → 10 → 11. **Import**: 12.

request.description:
This flow spans three real actors with three real roles, because the approval chain genuinely requires different people at each step (doc 04 §4 — that's the whole point of the state machine):

- **chompoo** (`chompoo@tcos.app`) — head + finance of the Finance department → creating a reimbursement there auto-verifies to head_approve immediately (doc 04 §4 auto-verify).
- **golf** (`golf@tcos.app`) — finance of the project → approves head_approve→fin_approve, assigns tracking_id; also approves payments.
- **beam** (`beam@tcos.app`) — owner role → fin_approve→transfer.

All three share the seed password `Passw0rd!2026`. `service_token` is `SERVICE_TOKEN_ENROLL` straight from `api/.env` — update the variable if yours differs.

POST /payments/approve and POST /reimbursements/:id/status both require step-up (`X-Reauth-Token`, doc 04 §9). A reauth token only works for the staff_id that verified it — swapping actors (golf → beam) means re-running POST /auth/verify-password as the NEW actor, even though the old token hasn't expired yet. Requests 5, 6b, and 9 each get one for whoever's about to act next — run them in order, don't skip 6b.

exec: pm.test('auto-verified straight to head_approve (chompoo heads this department)', () => {

request.description: #41 — chompoo is head of {{department_id}}, so this lands straight in head_approve, not waiting (doc 04 §4). meta.budget is a real computed projection, not a fixture.

item.name: 3. Document — request, html (ใบเบิกเงิน)

request.description: #48 — real rendered HTML (open the response in Postman's preview tab). type=voucher would 422 NOT_APPROVED right now — this reimbursement hasn't reached fin_approve yet.

#47 — needs a real X-Reauth-Token. If this 401s REAUTH_REQUIRED, run "9. Verify Password (get step-up token)" as golf first, then come back. golf is real finance on this project (StaffDept query, not the mock scope) so this is a genuine isFinance check passing, not a bypass.

item.name: 6b. Verify Password (get step-up token, as beam)

request.description: doc 04 §9 — a reauth token is scoped to whichever staff_id verified it (requireReauth checks the token's `sub` against the CALLER's own staffId, not just any valid token). Step 5's reauth token belongs to golf; step 7's caller is beam, so it needs its own — this is that one. Run this right before step 7, every time you re-run the collection.

#47 — owner-only (real role check, straight off beam's JWT). Rolls the ฿120.00 total up to department.total_expense/project.total_expense for real (no trigger does this yet, doc 02 §6 gap #1). Needs the reauth token from "6b. Verify Password (as beam)" run just before this — step 5's reauth token belongs to golf and will 401 REAUTH_REQUIRED here even though it's still valid, because it's the wrong person's.
#48 — ใบสำคัญจ่าย. Would have 422'd NOT_APPROVED before step 7; now latest_status is transfer, so it renders. golf sees the full bank account number (is_finance); a plain head would see it masked.

#37 — no Bearer token, X-Service-Token instead (never reachable with a user JWT — real, separate middleware). `{{$guid}}` (Postman's built-in dynamic variable) gives a fresh UUID each run; re-sending the exact same request body twice is what proves idempotency (second call returns 200 with the same row, not a new one — try it).

item.name: 9. Verify Password (get step-up token, as golf)

request.description: doc 04 §9 — 5-minute reauth token, scoped to golf's staff_id. Overwrites the `reauth_token` variable used by both the status-change and payment-approve requests.

#40 — golf is real finance on this payment's project (direct StaffDept query). Rolls source.actual_amount (and project/tag total_income) up for real, same transaction as the status insert. Run this twice in a row: the second run reports `outcome: "skipped"` for the same payment_id instead of erroring (doc 03 §8 idempotency).

#40 — there's no separate single-approve endpoint (doc 03 §8 note) — a batch of one is how you approve/reject just one payment. This one will report "skipped" if you already approved {{payment_id}} in step 10 (already-decided payments are skipped, not re-decided).

#49 — golf is finance on {{project_id}}. Attach a CSV to the `file` field with columns `requester_email,department,purpose,title,amount` (optionally `tag`), e.g.:
```
requester_email,department,purpose,title,amount
mark@tcos.app,IT,\u0e04\u0e48\u0e32\u0e2d\u0e38\u0e1b\u0e01\u0e23\u0e13\u0e4c\u0e44\u0e2d\u0e17\u0e35,\u0e2a\u0e32\u0e22 HDMI,5000
```
Every row lands straight in 'waiting' (or 'head_approve' if that row's requester heads the department) — same all-or-nothing validation as Staff's CSV import: one bad row (unknown email/department, not-a-member) rejects the whole file with a per-row error list, nothing gets created. This is a fixed column format, not the doc's aspirational per-project-configurable mapping — see Reimbursement.helper.js's #49 doc comment.
